name: io.github.unaibamir/agent-abilities-for-mcp
title: Agent Abilities for MCP
description: Self-hosted WordPress MCP server with per-capability permission controls and a full audit log.

hostname.description: Your WordPress site host, e.g. example.com. The plugin exposes its MCP endpoint at /wp-json/agent-abilities-for-mcp/mcp. Authenticate over OAuth (approve once in the browser, no secret in your config file) or an Application Password. Nothing is exposed until you enable abilities in wp-admin.
